pullRequests.title: Add PAL C for 7 new `differs` functions (50 Hz timings)
pullRequests.author: chistianh
pullRequests.head: pal-oficial-3
pullRequests.body:
Of the 21 differs rows that appeared on config/pal/map.tsv since #25, 9 have no PAL function with the same code. These are real PAL changes, and this PR covers 7 of them (the 8th is in note 1). The other 12 are not real differences (note 2).
Each PAL counterpart was found between the nearest US neighbours that the PAL map places, and each one converts a 60 Hz timing:

pullRequests.title: docs: decomp-permuter through OpenRAC's shared tool
pullRequests.author: Veradictus
pullRequests.head: docs/shared-permuter
pullRequests.body: Adds docs/PERMUTER.md, linked from CONTRIBUTING: how OpenRAC's tools/permuter runs decomp-permuter for rac4, US and PAL. Its profiles compile with tools/cc.sh (through wibo with a wine shim) and count a score 0 only when tools/check_func.py --version us|pal says MATCH. Docs only.
